question: Does the opt-in training-feedback reviewer still deliver all rows with its published ten-fit ceiling across different modalities?
design: Reuse identical pre-existing public development training packets, withheld prediction inputs, and frozen released-agent outputs. Three cold starts for the candidate, each with feedback-local and no prior memory. Freeze all new outputs before rescoring. Results are regression evidence on known public development material.
cases: UCI YouTube Spam (text, source held out, macro F1)
UCI Semeion (images, accuracy; original and shifted versions of the same 300 rows)
